gaps.sentence: Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
I fell ___ with my best friend over a silly remark.
gaps.explanation: fall out (with somebody) = have an argument and stop being friendly.

gaps.sentence: To sum ___, we need more time and a bigger budget.
gaps.explanation: sum up = summarize the main points.

gaps.sentence: We're trying to get rid ___ these old boxes.
gaps.explanation: get rid OF something = remove it.

gaps.sentence: We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
I've mixed ___ the twins' names again.
gaps.explanation: mix up = confuse one thing/person with another.

gaps.sentence: Put ___ your coat — it's freezing outside.
gaps.explanation: put on = dress in; put off = postpone.

gaps.sentence: I can't make ___ what the sign says from here.
gaps.explanation: make out = see, hear or understand with difficulty.
